takeaways.text: Lines up **Inline (tight)** on **44%** of 123 plays (n=54); also Slot 38% (n=47).
Route on **93%** / blocks on **7%** of dropbacks (95% CI 87–96%, n=123) — 6 pts above the TE average of 86%.
From **SINGLEBACK** (formation), route rate is **65%** (CI 41–83%, n=17) — less likely to run a route than his overall 93%.

Because he releases into a route on ~93% of dropbacks and most often from Inline (tight), a coach might account for him as a receiver there rather than expecting help in protection — to be validated against film and matchup.
